## Local Development

This project is confirmed working with Node.js 20. On macOS with Homebrew:

```sh
brew install node@20
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@20/bin:$PATH"
node -v
npm install
npm run develop
```

The Gatsby development server is available at:

```text
http://localhost:8000
```
